read.thesis: Verizon's Q3 2025 call shows postpaid phone net losses of 7,000 and a CEO admission that price-led growth is unsustainable; the read is a customer-retention reset funded by cost cuts, not supply discipline.

capex.quote: You can expect our capital envelope to support the completion of our C-band build-out and our long-term objectives for fiber expansion

triggers.label: Postpaid phone net adds -7,000
triggers.quote: resulted in postpaid phone net losses of 7,000 in the quarter

triggers.label: Price-led growth called unsustainable
triggers.quote: a strategic approach that relies too much on price without subscriber growth is not a sustainable strategy

triggers.label: 2025 FCF guide reaffirmed $19.5-20.5B
triggers.quote: we reiterated our guidance for the year at $19.5 billion to $20.5 billion for 2025

triggers.label: Legacy business exits, 2026 guidance deferred
triggers.quote: we will also aggressively sunset or exit legacy businesses where we don't see a clear path

guidance.metric: 2025 adjusted EBITDA, adjusted EPS, free cash flow
guidance.quote: we reiterated our guidance for the year at $19.5 billion to $20.5 billion for 2025

guidance.metric: Net unsecured debt to adjusted EBITDA leverage target
guidance.quote: We also remain committed to our long-term net unsecured leverage target range of 2.0 to 2.25x. This is not going to change.
